name: Amy J. Wong
office: City of Alhambra, Member of the City Council, First District

items.text: Amy J. Wong is a board consultant at the South Coast Air Quality Management District. She serves on the Alhambra Historic Preservation Commission and previously served on its Environmental Sustainability Commission. She has also worked for San Gabriel Valley nonprofits on parks, safer streets and clean air. She was an El Monte planning commissioner for five years.

sentences.text: Amy J. Wong is a board consultant at the South Coast Air Quality Management District.
She serves on the Alhambra Historic Preservation Commission and previously served on its Environmental Sustainability Commission.
She has also worked for San Gabriel Valley nonprofits on parks, safer streets and clean air.
She was an El Monte planning commissioner for five years.

items.text: Wong campaigned against a data center in Monterey Park and advocated for a similar ban on the November ballot in Alhambra. She supports accessible and responsive city government, expanded housing access, and revitalizing downtown vacancies and public spaces. At an October forum, she cited her background in pedestrian and bicycle safety and named affordability, climate change and immigration enforcement as priorities.
